_about: What each port needs from you, by Recompa port id. Only facts checked on this box or stated by the port's own README. Fields: game, version, file, check, goes, not, note; 'pick' tells OnnShell where the game reads its files, so it can ask for them before the first launch. Shown in the Store and on the Get warning.

mostwanted.file: The disc image: one .iso file, about 3.1 GB
mostwanted.check: default.xbe inside it has SHA-1 f636a16af04171089f879a4bed646e185c734233
mostwanted.goes: /sdcard/MostWanted. OnnShell asks for the file and copies it there the first time you start the game.
mostwanted.not: The PC version, the Xbox 360 version, other regions

nfsmw-android.file: The extracted game folder: default.xex plus the NFS and Movies folders
nfsmw-android.goes: The nsfmw-androidevolved folder on the box's storage. The port's Java launcher would normally copy them there; it does not run on this box.
nfsmw-android.not: PC installers or PC files. The listing says PC, but this build is the Xbox 360 recompilation.

gen1recomp.game: Pokemon Red, Blue or Yellow; FireRed, LeafGreen or Emerald also work
gen1recomp.file: The cartridge ROM: .gb or .gbc for Red, Blue and Yellow, .gba for FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald. Matched by SHA-1.
gen1recomp.goes: The game asks for it on first start, through OnnShell's file picker.

dkr-r.version: Nintendo 64, USA. Checked on this box: the first USA release (v1.0)
dkr-r.file: The cartridge ROM (.z64, .n64 or .v64), loose or inside a zip
dkr-r.check: v1.0 in .z64 byte order has SHA-1 0cb115d8716dbbc2922fda38e533b9fe63bb9670
dkr-r.goes: OnnShell finds it on the box, checks it is this game, and puts it in place the first time you start the game.
dkr-r.note: Runs slowly here for now, about 14 frames a second.

soh.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
soh.version: Nintendo 64. Checked on this box: USA v1.2. The port lists the other versions it accepts.
soh.file: The cartridge ROM (.z64, .n64 or .v64), loose or inside a zip
soh.goes: OnnShell puts it in place the first time you start the game and creates the SOH folder on the box's storage, where the game keeps its saves. The first start takes a few minutes while the game unpacks.

2ship2harkinian.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
2ship2harkinian.version: Nintendo 64. Checked on this box: USA
2ship2harkinian.file: The cartridge ROM (.z64, .n64 or .v64), loose or inside a zip
2ship2harkinian.goes: OnnShell puts it in place the first time you start the game; the first start takes a few minutes while the game unpacks.

super-metroid.version: Super Nintendo. Checked on this box: the Japan, USA release
